note: GB-10. Signed with the production signing bytes (`signed_bytes`) and a fixed key (32 bytes of 0x07); every case is checked by rustright-protocol tests/contract_vectors.rs against verify_receipt and verify_receipt_strict. Re-signed 2026-11-04 with D:\scratchr-measureesign-vectors.mjs (the gate's own canonicalJson, ES256 raw r||s), after failureClass moved from br19Evidence to payload.result. `lenient` is verify_receipt (a payload with no resultEvidence verifies); `strict` is verify_receipt_strict, which a gate applies to a compile receipt: it requires the signed resultEvidence object with exactly exit, signal, timingsMs, diagnosticsPath, timingsMs with exactly admission, queue, bind, cargo, afterExitBind, diagnostics, and every receipt copy equal to the signed value. 2026-11-04: the BR19 evidence carries `failureClass` (null on success, else admission, compile, test, tool, cancelled, timeout or broker), so every case that signs BR19 evidence signs it, and the file was re-signed with the same key by a throwaway signer (`strict` requires it to be null or a class).
